**Tier 2 brief:** <link to ruling-briefs/NNNN-<slug>.md, or "not required">
**Tier 3 panel:** comment `PANEL: <question>` to commission the four-model panel (advises, never rules).
**To rule:** reply `RULED: <option> — <one line>`. That comment is the ruling record; next session
transcribes it to the register with this issue as provenance, then closes with label `ruled`.
**Desk-only?** If this genuinely requires reading a long artefact end-to-end, the agent labels it
`desk-only` instead of compressing it.
